description:
# View Warehouse
In Miyano ERP the term 'warehouse' can be thought of as a storage location.

Warehouses are arranged in Miyano ERP in a tree like structure, where multiple sub-warehouses can be grouped under a single warehouse.

In this step we will view the **Warehouse Tree** to view the **Warehouses** that are set by default.
